content.description: The home of decentralized crypto gaming delivers the best-in-class experience across blockchain. Play games, build games, bankroll games - and become “The House.” Lotteries, Slot Machines, Table Games, and more await! Ridotto - Reinventing the gambling experience. Ridotto is the first cross-chain gambling and lottery protocol based on complete transparency, anonymity, security, and fairness. Our approach is to provide an open protocol, driven by the community, where users can play or build games and earn rewards by providing liquidity to the DeFi ecosystem.
